fees.notes: UNITAR publishes only local-student tuition on its programme pages ('Price listed above is applicable to local students only'); it publishes no international fee schedule. EasyUni/Uni Enrol list foreign-student tuition of about MYR 14,000-60,500 depending on programme; see individual programme files. Sources: https://www.unitar.my/programmes/, https://www.easyuni.my/malaysia/unitar-international-university-11409/courses/ (accessed 2026-09-18).
